entities.name: Raúl Curiel Garcia

entities.summary: Raúl Curiel Garcia is a Mexican professional boxer. He qualified for the men's light welterweight competition at the 2016 Summer Olympics through his top two AIBA Pro Boxing ranking but was unable to compete because of stomach flu.
